evaluation.case: Without Authorization, POST initialize returns HTTP 401 and does not disclose workspace data.
A revoked token returns HTTP 401 on the next request.
A token with content:read can list workspaces and content but cannot invoke a write tool.
A content:write token still cannot read or mutate a workspace outside the token owner's active internal access.
list_content rejects invalid UUIDs, dates, statuses, formats, and limits before the domain query runs.
reschedule_content changes only plannedPublishAt and preserves the workflow status and creative fields.
transition_content delegates invalid workflow actions to the existing state machine and returns an actionable error.
archive_content requires confirm=true and soft-archives only the selected item.
Repeated identical reschedule and owner-change calls are safe and do not create duplicate state changes.
After 120 requests in one minute for a token, the next request returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After.
export_brand_kit returns every brand-kit kind for an accessible workspace; logo binaries are referenced via short-lived signed download URLs (storage_path + token + expiresAt), not raw bytes.
import_brand_kit with conflict_strategy='merge' skips existing logo/color/font/voice-rule/publishing-rule/linked-resource names and reports the skipped list; new rows are still created.
import_brand_kit with conflict_strategy='fail' rejects on the first duplicate name and does not partially apply.

import_brand_kit with conflict_strategy='overwrite' requires confirm=true; without confirm the request is rejected by input validation. With confirm=true, the existing row is soft-archived and the new row is created.
import_brand_kit logo entries accept exactly one of external_url / source_url / base64. Submitting none, or more than one, fails input validation with a clear message.
import_brand_kit rejects logo source_url fetches that exceed the 10 MB cap or return non-2xx; the failure is reported per-row in `failed` without aborting the rest of the import.

export_brand_kit and import_brand_kit both reject requests against a workspace the token owner cannot access (canAccessInternalWorkspace / workspace_manager role), returning the existing not-found / permission-denied error shape.

list_workspaces without `name_query` returns every accessible workspace (cap 200); with `name_query` (case-insensitive substring, 1–120 chars after trim) returns only the matching subset and still respects canAccessInternalWorkspace.
list_workspaces with `name_query` containing SQL LIKE wildcards (`%` / `_`) treats them as literals (ESCAPE '\\') — the result set is not widened beyond the literal substring.
create_content accepts a complete format_payload for the selected format, writes it through the per-format Zod service, and get_content returns the normalized creative fields.

update_content accepts a complete format_payload for an editable draft, preserves the existing authorization and workflow rules, and rejects payload fields that do not satisfy the selected format schema.

Workbook-shaped format_payload preserves the full caption and visual direction, stores optional onImageText, weekday, platforms, requiredImageLinks, designReadyLink, publicationStatus, and additionalNotes, and does not infer hook/scenes/references when those fields are omitted.
A content-only token invoking a diagnostics tool is refused with `scope_required`; a content:write token does not imply platform:diagnostics:read, and vice versa.
A token holding platform:diagnostics:read but whose owner lacks the platform.console.read permission is refused with the generic permission error, and no error data is read or returned.
list_app_errors returns one row per error class with occurrenceCount, firstSeenAt, and lastSeenAt, newest first; a `query` matches the scrubbed message or the route.
diagnose_app_error returns a matchErrorHint root-cause hypothesis (id, why, fixes) plus the occurrence window, hourly histogram, and the distinct build versions the group was seen on.
diagnose_app_error reports found=false (not an error) for an unknown fingerprint, so an agent can branch on it without handling a tool failure.
get_app_error requires exactly one of id / fingerprint / request_id; zero or more than one fails input validation.
triage_app_error without confirm=true is rejected with invalid_request and performs no write; with confirm=true it sets resolvedAt idempotently, and action='reopen' clears it.
A platform:diagnostics:read token cannot invoke triage_app_error; that tool requires platform:diagnostics:write AND the platform.console.read permission.

Error messages, causes, and stacks returned by any diagnostics tool are scrubbed: credential shapes, Postgres DETAIL values, and email addresses never appear, while the constraint / route / class identifiers that make the error diagnosable do.

A hot error loop is bounded: the group's occurrenceCount keeps incrementing exactly while the number of persisted event rows stays within the per-minute burst cap, and app_health reports how many occurrences were capped.
